text:
nina_infra: noticed preview token estimates for several tenants jumped ~1.8x after we flipped adaptive sampling on embedding routes. quick triage suggests sample_weight applied in router + aggregator in some codepaths.

omar_sre: Confirmed in logs. Also seeing retries where SDKs generate new request_id so dedupe misses.

lucy_billing: ledger relies on request_id. Short fixes: (1) require SDK to emit x-client-retry-of on retry, (2) server-side fingerprint fallback. SDK path is slow. Prefer fingerprint but gate it.

ben_prod: UX ask: console needs an "est." badge and a provenance column (request_id | retry-header | fingerprint | pending). Customers want transparency.

nina_infra: implementation plan: accept x-client-retry-of in ingest shim, add fingerprint = sha1(tenant|model|trunc(prompt_sha1,12)) but only compute sync for tokens>1000 or tenants flagged heavy; otherwise async enrich and set dedupe_basis=pending.

lucy_billing: aggregator change: COALESCE(headers->>'x-client-retry-of', request_id, fingerprint) as dedupe_key. ledger will accept dedupe_basis field.

omar_sre: rollout: canary 3 tenants at 5% -> monitor metric metering.preview_estimate_ratio{route="embeddings"}, alert if >1.25 for 10m -> abort threshold 1.35. Runbook: flip shim to passthrough sample_rate and disable fingerprint fallback on abort.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: canary/ingest-shim v1.6 -> staging (owner: nina_infra) :rocket:

ben_prod: i'll draft console mock and RFC. Link it here when ready.

nina_infra: thanks — i'll post canary results after first hour.
